result:
Clean typecheck and all 617 tests pass. The implementation is complete:

- `src/config/constants.ts` — `ORG_SLUG_HOLD_DAYS = 30`.
- `src/schemas/organization.ts` — `renameOrganizationSlugSchema` / `RenameOrganizationSlugInput`.
- `src/server/db/schema/organizations.ts` + `migrate.ts` — new `organization_retired_slugs` table tracking each retired slug and when it was retired.
- `src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts` — `findOrgBySlug` now falls back to a still-held retired slug (the single choke point every slug→workspace lookup, including the session layer, goes through); `isSlugAvailableToOrg`, `findRetiredSlugOwner`, `findOrgByCurrentSlugAny`, `renameOrgSlug` implement the availability/retirement/chaining rules from ADR 0005; `listTakenOrgSlugs` now also avoids currently-held retired slugs so creation keeps suffixing away from them.
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` — `renameOrganizationSlug`: permission-checked like any org settings change, refuses (never suffixes) an unavailable slug via the existing `InvalidSlugError`, no-ops silently on a same-slug rename, and otherwise emits `organization.slug_changed` once.
- `src/types/event.ts` — new `organization.slug_changed` domain event.
- `src/types/activity.ts` / `src/schemas/activity.ts` — new `organization.slug_changed` audit action, accepted everywhere other actions are (including the audit-log filter schema).
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` — subscribes to the event and writes the one audit row (subject kind `organization`, subject id the workspace id, metadata `{from, to}`), so the single `emit` call satisfies "publishes once and records once."
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` — added the label for the new action (this is a total `Record<ActivityAction, string>`, so it was required for the build to typecheck).

I verified end-to-end with a throwaway test (since removed) covering rename, dual resolution of old/new slugs, refusal of a conflicting rename by another org, the same-slug no-op publishing nothing, the rename-back-to-a-retired-slug chain, and the permission refusal — all behaved per ADR 0005.
